CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top? (1 mark)
   A. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Old Testament Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Old Testament Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Old Testament Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Old Testament Prophets has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Old Testament Prophets.

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Bible.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Redemption after the Fall of Man? (1 mark)

   B. Say Redemption after the Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Redemption after the Fall of Man.
   D. Use Redemption after the Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

7. Which response best shows understanding of Loyalty to God? (1 mark)
   A. Say Loyalty to God has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Loyalty to God.
   C. Apply the teaching of Loyalty to God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Loyalty to God to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship Over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Stewardship Over Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Stewardship Over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship Over Creation.

9. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books.
   B. Use The New Testament Books to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The New Testament Books has no place in daily life.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

11. Which response best shows understanding of Background of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Background of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Exodus.
   C. Use The Exodus to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Exodus has no place in daily life.

14. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean ? (1 mark)
   A. Use The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Say The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  has no place in daily life.

15. Which response best shows understanding of The Sinai Covenant? (1 mark)

   C. Apply the teaching of The Sinai Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
